title: Quantum eMotion Completes C$32 Million ($22.5 Million USD) Acquisition of Cybersecurity Provider Plurilock Security - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
Quantum eMotion Corp. (NYSE American: QNC; TSXV: QNC; FSE: 34Q0) has closed its acquisition of Canadian cybersecurity company Plurilock Security Inc. (TSXV: PLUR; OTCQB: PLCKF) in a cash-and-stock transaction valued at approximately C$31.98 million ($22.5 million USD). Under the court-approved plan of arrangement, Quantum eMotion acquired 100% of Plurilock’s 114,231,441 common shares for C$0.084 in cash and 0.0763 of a Quantum eMotion share per Plurilock share, representing an implied price of C$0.28 per share.

The transaction pairs Quantum eMotion’s quantum-generated entropy and post-quantum cryptography portfolio with Plurilock’s established enterprise and public-sector cybersecurity operations, which span Critical Services, identity and access management, cloud security, and procurement channels across Canada, the United States, and NATO. Following shareholder approval on November 18 and final clearance from the Supreme Court of British Columbia on November 20, Plurilock’s shares are scheduled to delist from the TSX Venture Exchange on or about November 26.

Read Quantum eMotion’s official press release here, view the Newsfile announcement here, and read Plurilock CEO Ian Paterson’s post on LinkedIn here.
